notes: 82 PD patients, one effluent sample each; no independent test set: all 'validation' numbers are held-out folds of a stratified 5-fold CV with RandomOverSampler inside training folds. Imputation (MICE/RF) and the min-max bin edges are described as dataset-level preprocessing before CV (fit_on left not_reported since not stated). Table 1 footnote states 4 ranges and 39 200 TAs for both the full and the soluble subset; 39 200 = 5 x 20 x 2 x 196 fits only the 49-biomarker full set (the 40-biomarker soluble set would be 32 000) - a paper inconsistency, the record copies the caption. The record's datasets[0].booleanization mentions 2/3/4 intervals; the 5-class experiments (Table 1) only used 4. T=3 follows the authors' sqrt(C/2) rule; s for the 2- and 3-range binary models is not reported. The minimized-model accuracies (Figs. 5-8) come from a single best fold model after biomarker selection and clause pruning to a target accuracy; the evaluation data is not stated. Table 4 (minimal biomarker counts) and Table 3 train P/R/F1 are not in the record. Epochs/TA states not reported.
